# Bare · the least-effort benchmark

A benchmark, not a starter: an App that declares only what a coding agent's least effort would, so every screen is mistri's default; each release's visual matrix captures it to judge those defaults. Seed: [`test/fixtures/databases/bare`](../../databases/bare/seed.mjs).
For user or LLM authoring, start at [the public catalog](../../../../examples/apps/README.md); never grow this App to show a feature.
